metadata.purpose: A stream held across an sl goto over wide entries every revision holds unchanged: EdenFS returns each unmodified entry exactly once (TreeInode::readdir resumes at inode number + 2, and checkout keeps an unchanged entry's inode), so a repeated or missing name here is a real cookie instability. T287885560's own shape (every entry replaced) repeats replaced entries, which POSIX and TreeInode::readdir allow.
metadata.caveat: Re-aimed from the T287885560 shape (churn_all: true) after replaced-entry repeats were found legal.
